findings.title: A late or cross-tab bootstrap GET can restore a superseded session
findings.description: frontend/src/services/authService.js — inFlightCsrfFetch is per-tab and checked once, so a mount-time GET /api/auth/csrf can start after the check, or run in another tab. If that GET loaded session S and completes after login/redeem invalidated S and issued S', the browser applies the late Set-Cookie: S, restoring the previous principal after redeeming another user's link. The generation fence protects only the store write. Third finding in this area.
findings.suggested_action: Ensure no bootstrap GET can be in flight across a session change, in this tab or another.
